This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Chapter 17" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|orange]] skin, large nostrils, and small, light-colored spikes extending from their jaw.<ref name="Chapter 17" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|17}}</ref> a member of this species had taken up residence on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]],<ref name="Chapter 17" /> being part of the group that temporarily fled out to the lava flats after [[Nevarro City]] was bombarded by [[Pirate King]] [[Gorian Shard]]'s [[Gorian Shard's pirate Corsair|Corsair]], before [[Greef Karga]] rallied they and their peers to return and confront the surviving pirates at gunpoint.<ref name="Chapter 21">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 21: The Pirate}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 17: The Apostate|first episode]] of the [[The Mandalorian Season Three|third season]] of the television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],'' directed by [[Rick Famuyiwa]].<ref name="Chapter 17" />
